title: With growth exceeding 50% in 2026, The Gift Lab scales up
summary: Since 2010, The Gift Lab has been designing, sourcing, producing, and shipping gift sets, advent calendars, pouches, and promotional accessories (GWP) for beauty, luxury, and lifestyle brands. Founded by Alexandre Escarra, the France-based company leverages its office in China to maintain end-to-end control over the production chain, from initial concept to delivery. The Gift Lab has built a portfolio of around 50 clients in the beauty and luxury sectors. With revenue forecast to increase... - Packaging & design
